What if you took super hot showers every day?
A long, steamy shower is one of the best parts of a cold morning. It feels amazing, especially in winter. Hot water also helps sore muscles relax.

But here's the twist. Hot water strips the natural oils from your skin, so it gets dry and itchy, and it can make dandruff worse. Warm is better! Dermatologists suggest showers of about five to ten minutes, then moisturizer right after.
